pages.text: A large sample warehouse in the form of a freezer, $(bold)54 slots$().$(br2)Accepts life samples only (any purity); identical samples (source + purity) $(bold)auto-merge$() so storage never clogs.$(br2)Works with item pipes for input and output.
The Gene Analyzer and Potion Table both consume samples - place the vault next to them to $(bold)link access$() (see "Storage & Linking") and avoid backpack trips.
